pull-up.criteria: Pronated grip wider than shoulders, fixed bar and hands, chin above bar, controlled lowering toward straight arms without kipping.

lat-pulldown.criteria: Seated cable machine, overhand grip, stable trunk, pull in front toward upper chest, controlled return. Feet supported and thighs restrained.

leg-press.criteria: 45-degree sled, feet planted shoulder width, hips and back supported, controlled lowering and extension without forceful knee lockout.

limits: Procedural demonstration, not motion capture or biomechanical certification.
Simplified body, cloth, machines and cable routing; no entry/exit or safety-release operation shown. Eight-second illustrative cycle.
Actual phone and production deployment are unverified.
